country.evidence_quote: Currently operating in five countries (Peru, Ecuador, Chile, Colombia, and the United States), Grupo UNACEM has more than 100 years of history characterized by technological innovation, business growth, talent, and knowledge. Originally focused on concrete and cement, the business group is also involved in the energy and engineering sectors. Our Purpose: “Growing together to build a sustainable world.”
